name: Emptiness Sire
detailed_description:
In the 22nd century, the world collapsed

Humanity crumbled under the weight of inequality, the climate crisis, and the absolute control of megacorporations. While the elite isolated themselves in safe zones, the rest fought for survival in ruined cities. Technology became an instrument of domination. The air turned toxic. The sea swallowed civilizations.

Life became a rare privilege

The system was corrupted. Governments fell or bowed, reduced to puppets of the great corporations. In this scenario, He arrived.

They called Him a miracle. Or an omen. But the Emissary did not come to save.

The arrival of the Emissary

With Him came the meteor showers. Incandescent Fragments fell across the land, altering animals, nature — and, in mysterious ways, humans as well.

Even in a time of scarcity, food production suddenly increased. Some believed it was a new chance, a divine sign; however, others had their doubts.

The rise of the cults

They began around the Fragments, and entire communities formed to protect or exploit their effects. Soon, the news began to spread, and it didn’t take long before it reached the ears of the King, who immediately began mobilizing his envoys to start the search for the Fragments.

Whispers as a melody

The Fragments emitted sounds that seemed alive — an indescribable melody that resonated in the bones and the soul. To some, they were promises. To others, commands.

After the fall of the Great Meteor, those who approached the Fragments fell into a trance — fever, delirium, and then, transformation. The question emerged: were the Whispers a living entity, the Fragments an ancient force, or all of it a dark curse?

In a forest forgotten by time

There was a small village formed by ancient warriors who had survived the collapse. In this forest, different peoples came together to resist the threats of a ruined world, creating an isolated community marked by its traditions.
Among ancestral relics and stories passed down through generations, a young dreamer grew.

The beginning of the journey

When his village was attacked by enemies in search of a mysterious artifact, he took up the sword of his ancestors and set out on his first journey. A naïve, courageous, and determined man, with his sword — a symbol of hope to save lives and free his people.

Far beyond the horizon, in the shadows of great mountains

Deep caves shelter the few who still resist. There, where every drop of water and crumb of food is contested, survival is an art and an instinct learned early on.
In this hostile environment, a silent, solitary, and watchful survivor is born and grows. Amid the chaos, she discovers something rare: music, and her passion for it.

A mysterious flute

During an expedition, she finds this object of unknown origin and soon realizes its unusual power: the melody did more than just sound; in fact, it put even the most aggressive beasts to sleep. She did not yet understand why, but she kept the secret to herself.
Years later, she crossed paths with the King's envoys. They were searching for Fragments in her region, leaving death in their wake. It was then that she realized: the time to act had come.

A long time ago, a civilization dedicated to excavation and knowledge

With great effort, it rose again amidst the ruins of the old world. They repaired what the ancients had left behind, such as machines and ancient technologies, in search of a more just and stable life, even with little or almost no resources.

An act of devotion

In this place, inspired by her people and the quest for something better, she gave up her dominant arm to become a Guardian. Swapping it for the sacred gauntlet, she now carries a symbol of courage and memory.

The moment of decision

When the meteors fell, many saw them as a miracle. The Fragments brought abundance... but also madness. She watched everything crumble. And survived. But now, she must stop what she couldn’t face before.

Features:

Three unique and complementary characters.

Over 120 puzzles designed to challenge and surprise.

With the undo system, explore freely: rewind your moves and fix mistakes without restarting the entire puzzle

short_description: Emptiness Sire is a 2D isometric turn-based puzzle game set in a post-apocalyptic world ravaged by cosmic horrors. Control three heroes bound by a curse on a journey into the unknown where not all answers are meant to be found.
